import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int N = 12;
    static final int INF = 1000000009;
    static final int[] dx = {0, 1, 0, -1};
    static final int[] dy = {1, 0, -1, 0};

    static int n, t;
    static char[][] a = new char[N][N];
    static char[][] b = new char[N][N];
    static int sx, sy;
    static int[][] dist = new int[N][N];

    static void bfs(int startX, int startY) {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
            Arrays.fill(dist[i], INF);
        boolean[][] vis = new boolean[N][N];
        Queue<int[]> q = new ArrayDeque<>();
        vis[startX][startY] = true;
        dist[startX][startY] = 0;
        q.offer(new int[]{startX, startY});
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] p = q.poll();
            int x = p[0], y = p[1];
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                int nx = x + dx[k], ny = y + dy[k];
                if (nx >= 0 && nx < n && ny >= 0 && ny < n && !vis[nx][ny] && Character.isDigit(a[nx][ny])) {
                    vis[nx][ny] = true;
                    dist[nx][ny] = dist[x][y] + 1;
                    q.offer(new int[]{nx, ny});
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static int idx(int sx, int sy, int x, int y) {
        return ((sx * N + sy) * N + x) * N + y;
    }

    static final int STATES = N * N * N * N; // 20736
    static BitSet[] dp = new BitSet[72];
    static BitSet reachable = new BitSet(STATES);

    static class Edge {
        int to, rev, cap;
        Edge(int to, int rev, int cap) {
            this.to = to;
            this.rev = rev;
            this.cap = cap;
        }
    }

    static ArrayList<ArrayList<Edge>> graph;
    static int[] level, it;

    static void add_edge(int from, int to, int cap) {
        graph.get(from).add(new Edge(to, graph.get(to).size(), cap));
        graph.get(to).add(new Edge(from, graph.get(from).size() - 1, 0));
    }

    static boolean bfs_level() {
        Arrays.fill(level, -1);
        Queue<Integer> q = new ArrayDeque<>();
        level[0] = 0;
        q.offer(0);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int v = q.poll();
            for (Edge e : graph.get(v)) {
                if (e.cap > 0 && level[e.to] < 0) {
                    level[e.to] = level[v] + 1;
                    q.offer(e.to);
                }
            }
        }
        return level[2 * n * n + 1] >= 0;
    }

    static int dfs(int v, int f) {
        if (v == 2 * n * n + 1) return f;
        for (int i = it[v]; i < graph.get(v).size(); ++i) {
            Edge e = graph.get(v).get(i);
            if (e.cap > 0 && level[v] < level[e.to]) {
                int ret = dfs(e.to, Math.min(f, e.cap));
                if (ret > 0) {
                    e.cap -= ret;
                    graph.get(e.to).get(e.rev).cap += ret;
                    return ret;
                }
            }
            it[v] = i + 1;
        }
        return 0;
    }

    static void solv() {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        t = sc.nextInt();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            String s = sc.next();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j)
                a[i][j] = s.charAt(j);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            String s = sc.next();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j)
                b[i][j] = s.charAt(j);
        }
        sx = sc.nextInt();
        sy = sc.nextInt();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j)
                if (a[i][j] == 'Z') { sx = i; sy = j; }
        bfs(sx, sy);

        // Initialize dp[0]
        for (int i = 0; i < 72; ++i)
            dp[i] = new BitSet(STATES);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j)
                if (Character.isDigit(a[i][j]))
                    dp[0].set(idx(i, j, i, j));

        // DP transitions
        for (int yt = 0; yt < t; ++yt) {
            for (int s = 0; s < STATES; ++s) {
                if (!dp[yt].get(s)) continue;
                int sx_ = s / (N * N * N);
                int sy_ = (s / (N * N)) % N;
                int x = (s / N) % N;
                int y = s % N;
                if (dist[x][y] <= yt) continue;
                for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                    int nx = x + dx[k], ny = y + dy[k];
                    if (nx >= 0 && nx < n && ny >= 0 && ny < n && Character.isDigit(a[nx][ny]) && dist[nx][ny] >= yt + 1) {
                        dp[yt + 1].set(idx(sx_, sy_, nx, ny));
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // Build reachable set
        for (int yt = 0; yt <= t; ++yt)
            reachable.or(dp[yt]);

        // Build flow network
        int V = 2 * n * n + 2;
        graph = new ArrayList<>(V);
        for (int i = 0; i < V; ++i)
            graph.add(new ArrayList<>());
        level = new int[V];
        it = new int[V];

        // Source to first layer
        for (int x = 0; x < n; ++x)
            for (int y = 0; y < n; ++y)
                if (Character.isDigit(a[x][y]))
                    add_edge(0, x * n + y + 1, a[x][y] - '0');

        // Second layer to sink
        for (int x = 0; x < n; ++x)
            for (int y = 0; y < n; ++y)
                if (Character.isDigit(b[x][y]))
                    add_edge(n * n + x * n + y + 1, 2 * n * n + 1, b[x][y] - '0');

        // Edges between layers based on reachable
        for (int x1 = 0; x1 < n; ++x1)
            for (int y1 = 0; y1 < n; ++y1)
                if (Character.isDigit(a[x1][y1]))
                    for (int x2 = 0; x2 < n; ++x2)
                        for (int y2 = 0; y2 < n; ++y2)
                            if (Character.isDigit(a[x2][y2]) && reachable.get(idx(x1, y1, x2, y2)))
                                add_edge(x1 * n + y1 + 1, n * n + x2 * n + y2 + 1, INF);

        // Dinic max flow
        int flow = 0;
        while (bfs_level()) {
            Arrays.fill(it, 0);
            int f;
            while ((f = dfs(0, INF)) > 0)
                flow += f;
        }

        System.out.println(flow);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        solv();
    }
}
